product_name: SKYWORTH Chest Freezer 360 Liters - SCF 390_Dark Silver
description: SKYWORTH 360 Liter Hard Top Chest Freezer (SCF-390) A chest freezer is mainly designed for stocking frozen food products in massive quantities. If you are looking to buy a freezer to store frozen food for days, a chest freezer is all you need a large container operated by electricity, with a lid that opens at the top, that stores food at a very cold temperature so that it freezes and can be kept safely for a long time. Skyworth 360 Ltr Hard Top Chest Freezer is good choice of option. To make it simple, a freezer works by absorbing heat from the food and circulating cold air inside the appliance to keep the temperature conducive for the long-term storage of food. Chest freezers, also known as deep freezers, are less likely to have door storage since the door opens up rather than to the side. With chest freezers, you reach down into the unit to access food items; with upright freezers, you typically access food items on shelves while standing.
